title: LLM layer task: classify_error_handling (v1)
description: Request/response contract for the first LLM-layer task. The response is a structured output enforced by JSON schema; the LLM is never the sole oracle for a gate — a finding blocks merge only when a runtime observation confirms it.

task_version.description: Prompt/schema version, e.g. 2026-09-04.1. Logged with every call for eval-set construction.

text.description: Line-numbered slice text (prism review/json `slice_text`) for the enclosing function plus relevant callers/callees.

lines.description: Inclusive [start, end] line range of the slice text within `file` (CCR-1). Not a list of individual lines.

fault.description: The `fault` object from observations.schema.json (with catalog retryable/fatal semantics).

observation.description: The `observed` object from observations.schema.json, plus (CCR-4, 2026-09-04) the observation's top-level `log_excerpt` copied verbatim so the prompt's log-excerpt part (LLM-layer spec §6.2) is reachable.

log_excerpt.description: Reason prefixes plus the last 20 captured log records, verbatim from the observation (observations.schema.json `log_excerpt`).

text.description: Documented failure semantics of the dependency (e.g. 'HTTP 429 is retryable with Retry-After; 4xx other than 408/429 is not').

dependency_semantics.description: Documented failure semantics of the dependency. `source` is required so that an absent object and `{source: none}` are distinguishable (CCR-2).

observation_ref.description: Composite identity of the observation being classified — the runtime harness emits one observation per (target, fault, test) triple, so target_id alone is ambiguous (CCR-3, additive, optional).

fault_catalog_id.description: fault.catalog_id of the injected fault (probe observations with fault:null are never classified).

rationale.description: One to three sentences citing the observed outcome and the dependency semantics.

evidence_lines.description: Slice line numbers the rationale relies on.

regression_test.description: A test in the target language that injects the same fault and asserts the correct handling.
